title: Compact audit partitions and normalize shared lookup tables
creator: Ava Chen
description: This ticket consolidates several control-plane DB tech-debt tasks into a single, low-risk migration: compacting and partitioning the historical audit_log table, removing or normalizing duplicated lookup columns across multiple small tables (tag/region/status), and adding targeted partial indexes to speed hot queries. Goal: reduce storage and VACUUM pressure, improve join performance for control-plane reads, and enable faster backups without changing the public API.
acceptance_criteria: Audit_log partitioning implemented by month with a rolling maintenance job to combine tiny partitions older than 12 months
Created normalized lookup tables (e.g., region_codes, status_codes) and replaced inline enum-like columns with fk references for write paths under migration window
Tail latency for control-plane read queries that join audit_log and order/state tables decreases by >= 30% for 95th percentile on staging
End-to-end migration can run with <2 minutes of write-locked time per shard during cutover and supports quick rollback
Migration runbook and automated smoke tests present in repo; PRs reviewed and merged
migration_plan: Phase 1 (non-blocking): add partitioning support - create parent table audit_log and create monthly child partitions for last 24 months; backfill 1 month at a time during low-traffic windows
Phase 2: create canonical lookup tables and populate them from existing tables with idempotent inserts; update application code to write both legacy column and fk for dual-write testing
Phase 3: run traffic-shadowing reads against fk path and validate metrics vs legacy path for 48 hours
Phase 4: cutover writes to fk-only with short write lock per shard (expected <=120s) using logical replication per-region to keep replicas in sync
Phase 5: schedule compaction job that merges tiny partitions older than 12 months into quarterly partitions and VACUUM FULL them during maintenance windows
rollback_plan: If a regression is detected during cutover, re-enable dual-write reads and bulk-copy legacy column values back from fk join (script included). Revert application toggles and keep partitioned data intact; run a short replay to re-sync missing legacy fields if necessary.
monitoring: Create Prometheus alert for audit_log write latency spike (>200ms p95)
Dashboards: partition sizes, number of partitions, VACUUM duration, autovacuum backlog, index bloat estimate per table
Query logs: capture slow queries that touch audit_log and normalized lookup tables for 7 days post-migration

2025-02-21 - Priya Rao (DBA): Reviewed partitioning approach and suggested merging tiny partitions older than 12 months into quarterly partitions to reduce planner overhead. Also recommended pg_repack vs VACUUM FULL for less downtime; added to plan.
